loader-stuck-after-cipher-patch.title: Loader stuck after the Cipher patch
loader-stuck-after-cipher-patch.excerpt: Season 31 dropped and the loader just sits there. Did I brick it or is the file old?
body: yo cipher patch hit and my loader just spins. was fine yesterday. i did not touch hvci or secure boot.
status page still said green from before the patch. am i cooked or do i just wait for a new file? 😭

comments.author: ApexDev_K
comments.body: That green note was for the old client. After Cipher, read status again. If it says wait, do not keep launching. When it lists a new file, grab it from the portal and load that one. Same key. Do not turn security features off to force it.

replies.author: WraithMain_jay
replies.body: new file was up. launched clean. working 100% in pubs. thanks king

comments.author: octane_otp
comments.body: same. old file was the problem not the key. refreshed portal and it opened.

refund-if-menu-does-not-launch.title: Refund if the menu does not launch?
refund-if-menu-does-not-launch.excerpt: Before I buy: if it does not open on my pc do I get my money back?
body: thinking about the 31 day key. simple question before i pay.
if the menu does not launch on my pc, is that an auto refund? or do i just lose the money. be real with me.

comments.author: SupportStaff
comments.body: Checkout is final. We do not refund because you changed your mind, got an account penalty, or loaded while status said wait. If it fails on a supported pc (Windows 10 or 11, HVCI, core isolation, TPM, and secure boot left on, current portal file), email support with the order email, Windows version, and the exact loader text. If we confirm the fault is on our side we can fix it, replace access, or refund. That is not a yes for every ticket.

replies.author: horizon_tea
replies.body: ok that is clear. i will check the terms page before i buy. appreciate the straight answer.

comments.author: pathy_clips
comments.body: read terms first fr. the status note matters. do not queue on red.

boxes-eating-the-screen.title: Boxes eating my whole screen in a POI
boxes-eating-the-screen.excerpt: Turned every visual on and now I cannot see the door. What do you actually leave on?
body: first session i enabled box, skeleton, health, distance, weapon, loot. looked cool for 2 seconds then a building fight was unreadable.
what do you actually keep on so you can still see the model? i am lost ngl.

comments.author: SiteMod_Nia
comments.body: Drop it to a box and a health bar for the fight. Leave loot labels off until you are on a bin. Distance is optional on rotates, not inside the building. Save that as one config so you are not clicking twelve toggles mid round.

replies.author: bangalore_bench
replies.body: box + health only. i can see heads again. working 100% 🔥

comments.author: crypto_drone7
comments.body: loot on during the drop, off when i hear a door. that split helped me more than another color.

new-logins-die-on-one-pc.title: New logins die on this PC only
new-logins-die-on-one-pc.excerpt: Fresh accounts fail on my desktop and work on a laptop. Is that an ID ban?
body: old account on my laptop still queues. brand new logins on this desktop die early, sometimes before a real match.
is that a confirmed id ban? do i buy the spoofer or is the menu supposed to fix the login?

comments.author: ApexDev_K
comments.body: That pattern is the machine, not one email. It is not a confirmed ID ban by itself. In most cases there is no ID ban. The menu does not change disk or network ids. The spoofer is a separate key for a fingerprint problem on a pc you own. It does not undo a penalty that already sits on one account, and it is not an easy bypass claim.

replies.author: loba_loot
replies.body: tried a second pc first like you said. laptop is fine, desktop is the weird one. not treating it like a magic undo. thanks.

r301-spray-still-climbs.title: Spray still climbs on the R-301
r301-spray-still-climbs.excerpt: No Recoil is on but the last half of the mag still walks up. Did I set it wrong?
body: no recoil on, still the r-301 climbs after like half a mag. first bullets feel ok then it walks.
am i supposed to burst or is the slider just low? not trying to build a macro, just the menu option.

comments.author: ApexDev_K
comments.body: Shoot one mag at a wall with no mouse correction. Look at the opening, the middle, and the tail. A vertical slider shortens the climb. It does not erase a sideways walk at the end, so burst before the tail if it still slides. If the first shots drop under the crosshair, the slider is too high. This is not a jitter macro and not an adapter.

replies.author: gibby_bubble
replies.body: eased it off a notch and i burst the tail. beams feel normal now. working 100%.

vod-showed-the-menu.title: Stream showed my menu on the VOD
vod-showed-the-menu.excerpt: Went live and chat saw the menu. Stream proof was on. What did I set wrong?
body: stream proof on. i still saw the menu in my own recording. chat definitely saw it too. embarrassing.
scene is just the whole monitor because that was easier. is that why?

comments.author: SiteMod_Nia
comments.body: Yes. Display capture grabs the monitor, so viewers see what you see. Use game capture on the client window, record locally while still offline, and scrub the moment you open the menu before you go live. This does not cover a teammate recording their own pc.

replies.author: pathy_clips
replies.body: switched the source. local file is clean. working 100% before i hit go live next time.

loot-text-on-the-first-bin.title: Loot text covering the first bin
loot-text-on-the-first-bin.excerpt: Drop is a wall of labels. I just need the closest gun, not every attachment on the map.
body: hot drop and the floor is just words. i cannot tell which bin is the gun in my room.
i do not need every hop-up in the next building. how are you using loot labels in the first minute?

comments.author: SiteMod_Nia
comments.body: Three stops. Closest weapon you can take without crossing open ground. Then shield or heals, whichever is nearer. Then the exit away from the other balloons. Anything still glowing after that stays on the floor. A label is not an order to run back.

replies.author: octane_otp
replies.body: did the 3 stop thing. actually left with a gun. working 100% 💀

does-lifetime-include-spoofer.title: Does lifetime include the spoofer?
does-lifetime-include-spoofer.excerpt: Before I pay once: is the HWID tool inside the lifetime menu or a different checkout?

dont want to find out after checkout lol.

comments.author: SupportStaff
comments.body: Lifetime and the 31 day key unlock the same menu modules. Lifetime does not include the spoofer. That is its own checkout. Buy the menu for visuals and aim. Buy the spoofer only if the problem is the pc, not the account.

replies.body: bet. menu only for me then. clear.
